package.description: DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox — your existing configurations will continue to work, and you will have access to many advanced features.

en-US.description: DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox — your existing configurations will continue to work, and you will have access to many advanced features.
en-US.longDescription:
DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox with advanced features and current development practices.
It is a (mostly) drop-in replacement for older DOSBox versions—your existing configurations will continue to work, and you will have access to many advanced features.
DOSBox Staging comes with sensible defaults, so you’ll need to write a lot less configuration than with older DOSBox versions. Most games and applications require no tweaking and will work fine with the stock settings. However, the extensive configuration options and advanced features are available if you wish to delve deeper. Please refer to the Feature highlights on our front page to learn more about these.
en-US.name: DOSBox Staging

zh-CN.longDescription:
DOSBox Staging 是 DOSBox 的现代延续，具有先进的功能和当代的开发实践。
它是（大部分）旧版 DOSBox 的直接替代品——您不仅可以继续使用现有配置，还可以使用许多高级功能。
DOSBox Staging 附带了合理的默认配置，因此与旧版本的 DOSBox 相比，您需要编写的配置要少得多。大多数游戏和应用程序在默认配置下无需调整即可正常运行。不过，如果还想深入了解，您可以使用大量的配置选项和高级功能。请参阅首页上的功能亮点，了解更多相关信息。
